bends.note: Reading Road enters from the west edge running nearly east-west (slope ~-0.12), then turns to run NE (slope ~-0.80) toward East 12th and East 13th; same angle point as sheet 154's Reading Road bend (sheet 150 is drawn rotated ~13 deg relative to 154)
Gilbert runs ENE (slope ~-0.51) from the SW corner, then turns to run NE (slope ~-1.0) toward the east edge

notes: Sheet is almost all railroad yard (C.L.&N. / Penn. Co. engine house, turntable, Court St. freight house, Deer Creek fill) with heavy later pastes; only Reading Road (NW side), Gilbert Avenue (SE side) and the two cross streets entering from 154 carry street lines. The top cross street is printed 'WOODWARD ST.' (4" and 35" water pipes, ~60 ft between block lines); it is the street sheet 154 names East 13th Street (printed there 'E. 13TH (WOODWARD)') and meets Reading Road at the same spacing from East 12th, so it is named East 13th Street. 'E. 12TH ST.' (~47 ft, width not printed here) meets Reading Road below it. Both are T-junctions from the NW; the SE side of Reading Road is rail/industrial property. Reading Road is printed 70' on both stretches (measured ~248 px = 70 ft at ~3.5 px/ft). Gilbert Avenue is printed 'GILBERT' / 100'. Near the east edge the NW building line turns steeply north at ~(3715,2590): that steeper line (fronts 1107, 1109) is the west line of the street sheet 160 prints 'ACCOMODATION' (40 ft), which forks off Gilbert here. The Gilbert/Accomodation Street point is computed as the crossing of Gilbert's centreline with a line 69 px (20 ft) inside Accomodation's west line; the fork angle is only ~23 deg and Accomodation's east line is not drawn on this sheet, so this point is uncertain by perhaps 25-30 px along Gilbert. A block corner on the SE side of Gilbert at ~(1000,4560) marks a street from the SE (sheet 144) whose centreline crossing is off the bottom of the sheet; not recorded. A vertical line at x~370 south of Reading Road at the west edge is a property line, not a street.
